newsitem.title: UK: British cabinet to hold key pre-election meeting.
newsitem.headline: British cabinet to hold key pre-election meeting.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major has invited his cabinet colleagues to his official country home, Chequers, on Monday for a key pre-election meeting, officials of the ruling Conservative Party said.
With an election due within the next four months, and possible as early as March 20, ministers are expected to discuss pledges for insertion in the party's manifesto.

British Sunday newspapers speculated that key planks of the programme will include moves to raise billions of pounds by selling off government property and buildings, and state agencies such as the benefits agency and national savings.
They also suggested there could be important promises on education, including possibly the removal of local authority control over state schools.

Ministers are also expected to consider how to avoid the issues on which the party is divided -- principally Europe -- from impeding their drive for a fifth consecutive Conservative victory at the polls.
The meeting is expected to last most of the day. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427947
